title: Madhya-khanda, part 20 (portion 43)
html:
The section "The Lord's Journey to Nilachala; the Broken Staff" (end): the Lord walks with His companions to Nilachala absorbed in prema, singing the verse "Rama Raghava"; toll-collectors release the pilgrims; Nityananda breaks the Lord's staff and answers His anger

সভারে বিদায় দিয়া চলিলা ঠাকুর ।
শূন্যাকার কৈল সব নবদ্বীপপুর ॥ ৮১ ॥

sabhāre bidāẏa diẏā calilā ṭhākura |
śūnyākāra kaila saba nabadbīpapura || 81 ||

sabhare vidaya diya — taking leave of all; chalila thakura — the Thakura set out; shunyakara kaila — made empty; saba navadvipa-pura — the whole town of Navadvipa

81Having taken leave of all, the Thakura set out —
and the whole town of Navadvipa was left empty.1

পণ্ডিত শ্রীগদাধর, অবধূতরায় ।
নরহরি-আদি কথোজন সঙ্গে যায় ॥ ৮২ ॥

paṇḍita śrīgadādhara, abadhūtarāẏa |
narahari-ādi kathojana saṅge yāẏa || 82 ||

pandita shri-gadadhara — Pandita Sri Gadadhara; avadhuta-raya — the royal Avadhuta; narahari-adi — Narahari and others; kathojana — a few people; sange yaya — go with [Him]

82Pandita Sri Gadadhara, the royal Avadhuta,
Narahari and a few others go with Him;

শ্রীনিবাস, মুরারি, মুকুন্দ, দামোদর ।
এই নিজজন-সঙ্গে চলিলা ঈশ্বর ॥ ৮৩ ॥

śrīnibāsa, murāri, mukunda, dāmodara |
ei nijajana-saṅge calilā īśbara || 83 ||

shrinivasa, murari, mukunda, damodara — Srinivasa, Murari, Mukunda, Damodara; ei nijajana-sange — with these His own people; chalila ishvara — the Lord set out

83Srinivasa, Murari, Mukunda, Damodara —
with these His own people the Lord set out.2

জগন্নাথ দোলেতে দেখিব মনে করি' ।
সত্বরে চলিলা প্রভু বলি' হরি হরি ॥ ৮৪ ॥

jagannātha dolete dekhiba mane kari' |
satbare calilā prabhu bali' hari hari || 84 ||

jagannatha dolete dekhiba — I shall see Jagannatha at the Dola [festival]; mane kari — thinking; satvare chalila prabhu — the Lord set out quickly; bali hari hari — crying "Hari! Hari!"

84"I shall see Jagannatha at the Dola festival," He thought,
and the Lord set off in haste, crying "Hari! Hari!"3

প্রেমায় বিভোল প্রভু চলি' যায় পথে ।
টলমল করে তনু না পারে হাঁটিতে ॥ ৮৫ ॥

premāẏa bibhola prabhu cali' yāẏa pathe |
ṭalamala kare tanu nā pāre hāṁṭite || 85 ||

premaya bhibhola prabhu — the Lord, overwhelmed with prema; chali yaya pathe — goes along the road; talamala kare tanu — His body sways; na pare hantite — He cannot walk

85Overwhelmed with prema, the Lord walks along the road;
His body sways, He cannot walk.

ক্ষণে শীঘ্রগতি ধায় সিংহপরাক্রমে ।
ক্ষণে হুহুঙ্কার দেই ডাকে হরিনামে ॥ ৮৬ ॥

kṣaṇe śīghragati dhāẏa siṃhaparākrame |
kṣaṇe huhuṅkāra dei ḍāke harināme || 86 ||

kshane shighra-gati dhaya — now He rushes swiftly; simha-parakrame — with a lion's might; kshane huhunkara dei — now He roars; dake hari-name — calls out the name of Hari

86Now He rushes swiftly with the might of a lion,
now He roars aloud and calls out the name of Hari;

ক্ষণে নাচে ক্ষণে গায় সকরুণ কান্দে ।
ক্ষণে মালসাট মারে প্রেমার উন্মাদে ॥ ৮৭ ॥

kṣaṇe nāce kṣaṇe gāẏa sakaruṇa kānde |
kṣaṇe mālasāṭa māre premāra unmāde || 87 ||

kshane nache — now He dances; kshane gaya — now sings; sakaruna kande — weeps piteously; kshane malasata mare — now slaps His arms; premara unmade — in the madness of prema

87now He dances, now sings, now weeps piteously,
now in the madness of prema He slaps His arms.

অরুণ-নয়ানে জলধারা অনিবার ।
বিপুল-পুলকে সে ঢাকিল কলেবর ॥ ৮৮ ॥

aruṇa-naẏāne jaladhārā anibāra |
bipula-pulake se ḍhākila kalebara || 88 ||

aruna-nayane — from the reddish eyes; jaladhara anibara — ceaseless streams of tears; vipula-pulake — with abundant thrill (hair standing on end); se dhakila kalebara — the body was covered

88From His reddish eyes streams of tears flow without cease,
and the hair on His whole body stands on end.

ক্ষণেকে মন্থরগতি অলৌকিক কহে ।
ক্ষণে অট্ট-অট্ট হাসে দাঁড়াইয়া রহে ॥ ৮৯ ॥

kṣaṇeke mantharagati alaukika kahe |
kṣaṇe aṭṭa-aṭṭa hāse dāṁṛāiẏā rahe || 89 ||

kshaneke manthara-gati — at times with slow gait; alaukika kahe — speaks unearthly things; kshane atta-atta hase — at times laughs aloud; dandaiya rahe — stands still

89At times He walks slowly and says unearthly things,
at times He stands still and laughs aloud.

যদি বা কখন ভক্ষ্য উপসন্ন হয় ।
'নিবেদিত নহে' বলি' কিছুই না লয় ॥ ৯০ ॥

yadi bā kakhana bhakṣya upasanna haẏa |
'nibedita nahe' bali' kichui nā laẏa || 90 ||

yadi va kakhana — if ever; bhakshya upasanna haya — food is brought; nivedita nahe bali — saying "not offered"; kichhui na laya — He takes nothing

90If ever food is brought to Him,
He says, "This is not offered [to Krishna]," and takes nothing.

অনেক যতনে দুই তিনে করে ভিক্ষা ।
লোক-অনুগ্রহে সে প্রকাশে লোকশিক্ষা ॥ ৯১ ॥

aneka yatane dui tine kare bhikṣā |
loka-anugrahe se prakāśe lokaśikṣā || 91 ||

aneka yatane — with great effort; dui tine kare bhiksha — accepts alms once in two or three [days]; loka-anugrahe — out of mercy for people; se prakashe loka-shiksha — He shows a lesson to people

91Only with great effort [is He persuaded] to accept alms — once in two or three [days]:
out of mercy for people He shows them a lesson.4

সব-নিশি জাগরণ — লয় হরিনাম ।
ডাকিয়া পঢ়য়ে এই শ্লোক গুণধাম ॥ ৯২ ॥

saba-niśi jāgaraṇa — laẏa harināma |
ḍākiẏā paṛhaẏe ei śloka guṇadhāma || 92 ||

saba-nishi jagarana — awake all night; laya harinama — He chants the name of Hari; dakiya padhaye — recites aloud; ei shloka gunadhama — this verse, abode of virtues

92All night He stays awake and chants the name of Hari;
aloud He recites this verse, the abode of virtues.

Thus:

রাম রাঘব রাম রাঘব রাম রাঘব রক্ষ মাম্ ।
কৃষ্ণ কেশব কৃষ্ণ কেশব কৃষ্ণ কেশব পাহি মাম্ ॥ ৯৩ ॥

rāma rāghaba rāma rāghaba rāma rāghaba rakṣa mām |
kṛṣṇa keśaba kṛṣṇa keśaba kṛṣṇa keśaba pāhi mām || 93 ||

rama raghava — Rama, Raghava; raksha mam — protect me; krishna keshava — Krishna, Keshava; pahi mam — save me

93"Rama, Raghava, Rama, Raghava, Rama, Raghava, protect me!
Krishna, Keshava, Krishna, Keshava, Krishna, Keshava, save me!"5

এই শ্লোক সুমধুর-স্বরে গায় পঁহু ।
প্রেমার আনন্দে গদগদ ভাষে লহু ॥ ৯৪ ॥

ei śloka sumadhura-sbare gāẏa paṁhu |
premāra ānande gadagada bhāṣe lahu || 94 ||

ei shloka — this verse; sumadhura-svare — in the sweetest voice; gaya panhu — the Lord sings; premara anande — in the bliss of prema; gadagada bhashe — in faltering speech; lahu — softly

94This verse the Lord sings in the sweetest voice —
softly, in faltering speech, in the bliss of prema.

দোলে জগন্নাথ দেখিবারে যাত্রিগণ ।
প্রভুসঙ্গে যায় তারা আনন্দিত-মন ॥ ৯৫ ॥

dole jagannātha dekhibāre yātrigaṇa |
prabhusaṅge yāẏa tārā ānandita-mana || 95 ||

dole jagannatha dekhibare — to see Jagannatha at the Dola; yatri-gana — the pilgrims; prabhu-sange yaya tara — they go with the Lord; anandita-mana — joyful at heart

95Pilgrims going to see Jagannatha at the Dola festival
walk along with the Lord with joy in their hearts.

এককালে একঠাঞি যাত্রিক-সমূহ ।
পথে রাখিয়াছে দানী পাপিষ্ঠ দুরূহ ॥ ৯৬ ॥

ekakāle ekaṭhāñi yātrika-samūha |
pathe rākhiẏāche dānī pāpiṣṭha durūha || 96 ||

ekakale — once; ekathani — at one place; yatrika-samuha — a crowd of pilgrims; pathe rakhiyachhe — has held up on the road; dani — a toll-collector; papishtha duruha — sinful, cruel

96Once, at one place, a crowd of pilgrims
was held up on the road by a toll-collector, sinful and cruel.6

অনেক যন্ত্রণা দুঃখ দিছে তা-সভারে ।
আগাইয়াছিলা প্রভু লেউটে সত্বরে ॥ ৯৭ ॥

aneka yantraṇā duḥkha diche tā-sabhāre |
āgāiẏāchilā prabhu leuṭe satbare || 97 ||

aneka yantrana duhkha — much torment and grief; dichhe ta-sabhare — he gives them all; agaiyachhila prabhu — the Lord, who had gone ahead; leute satvare — quickly turns back

97He was giving them much torment and grief.
The Lord, who had gone ahead, quickly turns back.

অবধূত গদাধর-পণ্ডিত বিস্ময় ।
কি কারণে পুনঃ লেউটিয়া প্রভু যায় ॥ ৯৮ ॥

abadhūta gadādhara-paṇḍita bismaẏa |
ki kāraṇe punaḥ leuṭiẏā prabhu yāẏa || 98 ||

avadhuta gadadhara-pandita — the Avadhuta and Gadadhara Pandita; vismaya — are amazed; ki karane — why; punah leutiya prabhu yaya — the Lord turns back again

98The Avadhuta and Gadadhara Pandita are amazed:
"Why has the Lord turned back again?"

চিন্তিতে চিন্তিতে তারা যায় পাছে পাছে ।
কথোদূরে দেখে দানী যাত্রী বান্ধিয়াছে ॥ ৯৯ ॥

cintite cintite tārā yāẏa pāche pāche |
kathodūre dekhe dānī yātrī bāndhiẏāche || 99 ||

chintite chintite — wondering; tara yaya pachhe pachhe — they follow behind; kathodure dekhe — a little way off they see; dani yatri bandhiyachhe — the toll-collector has bound the pilgrims

99Wondering, they follow behind Him
and a little way off they see: the toll-collector has bound the pilgrims.

কারণ দেখিয়া তারা ভেল চমকিত ।
পুলক-ভরল অঙ্গ — অতি আনন্দিত ॥ ১০০ ॥

kāraṇa dekhiẏā tārā bhela camakita |
pulaka-bharala aṅga — ati ānandita || 100 ||

karana dekhiya — seeing the reason; tara bhela chamakita — they started; pulaka-bharala anga — their bodies filled with thrill; ati anandita — greatly rejoicing

100Seeing the reason, they started;
their hair stood on end and they were filled with joy.

যাত্রিকে দেখিয়া প্রভু বিরস-বদন ।
ত্বরায়ে চলিলা মত্তসিংহের গমন ॥ ১০১ ॥

yātrike dekhiẏā prabhu birasa-badana |
tbarāẏe calilā mattasiṃhera gamana || 101 ||

yatrike dekhiya — seeing the pilgrims; prabhu birasa-badana — the Lord, sad-faced; tvaraye chalila — went quickly; matta-simhera gamana — with the gait of an enraged lion

101Seeing the pilgrims, the Lord's face grew sad,
and He hurried forward with the gait of an enraged lion.

প্রভুকে দেখিয়া যাত্রী কান্দে উভরায় ।
ত্রাস পাঞা শিশু যেন মায়ের কোল পায় ॥ ১০২ ॥

prabhuke dekhiẏā yātrī kānde ubharāẏa |
trāsa pāñā śiśu yena māẏera kola pāẏa || 102 ||

prabhuke dekhiya — seeing the Lord; yatri kande ubharaya — the pilgrims weep aloud; trasa panya shishu — a frightened child; yena mayera kola paya — as if reaching its mother's lap

102Seeing the Lord, the pilgrims weep aloud —
like a frightened child that has reached its mother's lap,

দীন বনজন্তু যেন দগ্ধ দাবানলে ।
সন্তপ্ত হইয়া পড়ে জাহ্নবীর জলে ॥ ১০৩ ॥

dīna banajantu yena dagdha dābānale |
santapta haiẏā paṛe jāhnabīra jale || 103 ||

dina bana-jantu — wretched forest creatures; yena dagdha davanale — as if scorched by a forest fire; santapta haiya — tormented; pade jahnavira jale — plunge into the waters of the Jahnavi

103like wretched forest creatures scorched by a forest fire
that, tormented, plunge into the waters of the Jahnavi.

প্রভুর চরণে পড়ি' কান্দে যাত্রিগণ ।
দেখিয়া পাপিষ্ঠ দানী গণে মনে মন ॥ ১০৪ ॥

prabhura caraṇe paṛi' kānde yātrigaṇa |
dekhiẏā pāpiṣṭha dānī gaṇe mane mana || 104 ||

prabhura charane padi — falling at the Lord's feet; kande yatri-gana — the pilgrims weep; dekhiya — seeing [this]; papishtha dani — the sinful toll-collector; gane mane mana — thinks to himself

104The pilgrims weep, fallen at the Lord's feet;
seeing this, the sinful toll-collector thinks to himself:

এরূপ মানুষ নাহি জগত-ভিতর ।
এই নীলাচলচন্দ্র জানিল অন্তর ॥ ১০৫ ॥

erūpa mānuṣa nāhi jagata-bhitara |
ei nīlācalacandra jānila antara || 105 ||

erupa manusha nahi — there is no such man; jagata-bhitara — in the world; ei nilachala-chandra — this is the Moon of Nilachala; janila antara — he knew in his heart

105"There is no such man in the world!"
He understood in his heart: this is the Moon of Nilachala.7

ইহা-সভাকারে আমি দিলুঁ এত দুঃখ ।
কি করয়ে জানি' মোর ডরে কাঁপে বুক ॥ ১০৬ ॥

ihā-sabhākāre āmi diluṁ eta duḥkha |
ki karaẏe jāni' mora ḍare kāṁpe buka || 106 ||

iha-sabhakare — to all these; ami dilun eta duhkha — I have given so much grief; ki karaye jani — who knows what He will do; mora dare — from fear my; kampe buka — heart trembles

106"I have given them all so much grief —
who knows what He will do? My heart trembles with fear."

এতেক চিন্তিয়া মনে সেই মহাদানী ।
প্রভুর চরণে পড়ি' বোলে কাকু-বাণী ॥ ১০৭ ॥

eteka cintiẏā mane sei mahādānī |
prabhura caraṇe paṛi' bole kāku-bāṇī || 107 ||

eteka chintiya mane — thinking thus; sei maha-dani — that great toll-collector; prabhura charane padi — falling at the Lord's feet; bole kaku-bani — speaks piteous words

107Thinking thus, that great toll-collector
fell at the Lord's feet and speaks piteous words:

ছাড়িলুঁ যাত্রিকগণ — না সাধিব দান ।
অন্তরে জানিলুঁ প্রভু — তুমি ভগবান্ ॥ ১০৮ ॥

chāṛiluṁ yātrikagaṇa — nā sādhiba dāna |
antare jāniluṁ prabhu — tumi bhagabān || 108 ||

chhadilun yatrika-gana — I have released the pilgrims; na sadhiba dana — I shall not take the toll; antare janilun — I have known in my heart; prabhu — Lord; tumi bhagavan — You are Bhagavan

108"I have released the pilgrims, I shall not take the toll:
I have understood in my heart, Lord — You are Bhagavan."

ইহা বলি' চরণে পড়িয়া সেই কান্দে ।
তাহার মাথাতে দিল চরণারবিন্দে ॥ ১০৯ ॥

ihā bali' caraṇe paṛiẏā sei kānde |
tāhāra māthāte dila caraṇārabinde || 109 ||

iha bali — saying this; charane padiya — fallen at His feet; sei kande — he weeps; tahara mathate dila — He placed on his head; charanaravinde — His lotus feet

109Saying this, he weeps, fallen at His feet,
and [the Lord] placed His lotus feet upon his head.

কম্প-গদগদ-স্বরে নানা স্তব করে ।
বিষয়ী বলিয়া ঘৃণা না করিহ মোরে ॥ ১১০ ॥

kampa-gadagada-sbare nānā staba kare |
biṣaẏī baliẏā ghṛṇā nā kariha more || 110 ||

kampa-gadagada-svare — trembling, in a choked voice; nana stava kare — offers many praises; vishayi baliya — as a worldly man; ghrina na kariha more — do not despise me

110Trembling, in a choked voice he offers many praises:
"Do not despise me because I am a worldly man."

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু মুচকি হাসিয়া ।
সুখে চলি' যান যাত্রিগণ ছাড়াইয়া ॥ ১১১ ॥

e bola śuniñā prabhu mucaki hāsiẏā |
sukhe cali' yāna yātrigaṇa chāṛāiẏā || 111 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; prabhu muchaki hasiya — the Lord, smiling faintly; sukhe chali yana — walks on happily; yatri-gana chhadaiya — having freed the pilgrims

111Hearing this, the Lord smiled faintly
and walks on happily, having set the pilgrims free.

হেনই সময়ে কথোদূরে আর দানী ।
ডাকিতে ডাকিতে আইসে উভ করি' পাণি ॥ ১১২ ॥

henai samaẏe kathodūre āra dānī |
ḍākite ḍākite āise ubha kari' pāṇi || 112 ||

henai samaye — just then; kathodure — a little way off; ara dani — another toll-collector; dakite dakite aise — comes calling out; ubha kari pani — with his hand raised

112Just then, a little way off, another toll-collector
comes calling out to them with his hand raised.

দেখিয়া ঠাকুর তাহে উভ কৈল বাই ।
হাথসানে সেই দানী রহে সেই ঠাঞি ॥ ১১৩ ॥

dekhiẏā ṭhākura tāhe ubha kaila bāi |
hāthasāne sei dānī rahe sei ṭhāñi || 113 ||

dekhiya thakura — seeing [him], the Thakura; tahe ubha kaila bai — raised His arm to him; hathasane — at the sign of the hand; sei dani rahe — that toll-collector stayed; sei thani — in that place

113Seeing him, the Thakura raised His arm in reply —
and at that sign the toll-collector stopped where he was.

ঝরঝর নয়ন — পুলক কলেবর ।
হরে-কৃষ্ণ-নাম সেই বোলে নিরন্তর ॥ ১১৪ ॥

jharajhara naẏana — pulaka kalebara |
hare-kṛṣṇa-nāma sei bole nirantara || 114 ||

jharajhara nayana — tears stream from his eyes; pulaka kalebara — his body thrills; hare-krishna-nama — the name "Hare Krishna"; sei bole nirantara — he says ceaselessly

114Tears stream from his eyes, his hair stands on end;
ceaselessly he chants the name "Hare Krishna."

দেখি' নিত্যানন্দ-গদাধরের উল্লাস ।
গৌরাঙ্গ-চরিত্র কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ১১৫ ॥

dekhi' nityānanda-gadādharera ullāsa |
gaurāṅga-caritra kahe e locanadāsa || 115 ||

dekhi — seeing; nityananda-gadadharera ullasa — the jubilation of Nityananda and Gadadhara; gauranga-charitra — the deeds of Gauranga; kahe e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa tells

115Seeing the jubilation of Nityananda and Gadadhara,
Lochana Dasa tells the deeds of Gauranga.

Raga sindhura; disha: "Brothers, sing, sing, hear of the virtues of Gora Gosani! (murchha) Aho, aho, aho! Long for the lotus feet of Gauranga. All that you see in the world you count as your own — ho-ho-ho, ho-ho-ho, brothers — yet all of it is vain forever. Brothers, sing, sing, hear of Gora's virtues!"8

এইমতে গোরাচাঁদ চলি' যায় পথে ।
যেখানে যে দেবস্থল দেখিতে দেখিতে ॥ ১১৬ ॥

eimate gorācāṁda cali' yāẏa pathe |
yekhāne ye debasthala dekhite dekhite || 116 ||

eimate — thus; gorachanda chali yaya pathe — Gorachand walks along the road; yekhane ye deva-sthala — whatever holy places there are; dekhite dekhite — looking at them

116Thus Gorachand walks along the road,
looking at every holy place He comes upon.

রহি' রহি' যায় প্রভু প্রতি গ্রামে গ্রামে ।
নর্তন করিয়া যায় দেবতার স্থানে ॥ ১১৭ ॥

rahi' rahi' yāẏa prabhu prati grāme grāme |
nartana kariẏā yāẏa debatāra sthāne || 117 ||

rahi rahi yaya prabhu — the Lord goes, stopping again and again; prati grame grame — in every village; nartana kariya yaya — dances and goes on; devatara sthane — at the shrines of the gods

117The Lord goes on, stopping in every village,
and dances at the shrines of the gods.

এক অদ্ভুত কথা শুন তার মাঝে ।
যে করিলা নিত্যানন্দ অবধূতরাজে ॥ ১১৮ ॥

eka adbhuta kathā śuna tāra mājhe |
ye karilā nityānanda abadhūtarāje || 118 ||

eka adbhuta katha — one wondrous story; shuna tara majhe — hear, in the midst of this; ye karila nityananda — what Nityananda did; avadhuta-raje — the king of avadhutas

118Hear of one wondrous thing on the way —
what Nityananda, the king of avadhutas, did.

নিত্যানন্দ-করে দণ্ড দিয়া গৌরহরি ।
কিছু আগাইলা নিত্যানন্দ পাছু করি' ॥ ১১৯ ॥

nityānanda-kare daṇḍa diẏā gaurahari |
kichu āgāilā nityānanda pāchu kari' || 119 ||

nityananda-kare — into Nityananda's hand; danda diya — giving the staff; gaurahari — Gaurahari; kichhu agaila — went somewhat ahead; nityananda pachhu kari — leaving Nityananda behind

119Gaurahari gave His staff into Nityananda's hand
and went somewhat ahead, leaving Nityananda behind.

প্রেমায় বিহ্বল প্রভু যায় মহাবেগে ।
আপনা পাসরে কৃষ্ণপ্রেম-অনুরাগে ॥ ১২০ ॥

premāẏa bihbala prabhu yāẏa mahābege |
āpanā pāsare kṛṣṇaprema-anurāge || 120 ||

premaya vihvala prabhu — the Lord, overwhelmed with prema; yaya maha-vege — goes very fast; apana pasare — forgets Himself; krishna-prema-anurage — in passionate love for Krishna

120Overwhelmed with prema, the Lord walks very fast,
forgetting Himself in passionate love for Krishna.

গদাধর-আদি যত গণ সঙ্গে যায় ।
দেখি' নিত্যানন্দ আরো দূরে পাছু হয় ॥ ১২১ ॥

gadādhara-ādi yata gaṇa saṅge yāẏa |
dekhi' nityānanda āro dūre pāchu haẏa || 121 ||

gadadhara-adi yata gana — Gadadhara and all the companions; sange yaya — go with [Him]; dekhi nityananda — seeing this, Nityananda; aro dure pachhu haya — falls still farther behind

121Gadadhara and all the companions go with Him;
seeing this, Nityananda falls still farther behind.

গুণিতে গুণিতে প্রভু যায় ধীরে ধীরে ।
মোর বিদ্যমানে প্রভু দণ্ড ধরে করে ॥ ১২২ ॥

guṇite guṇite prabhu yāẏa dhīre dhīre |
mora bidyamāne prabhu daṇḍa dhare kare || 122 ||

gunite gunite — pondering; prabhu yaya dhire dhire — Prabhu [Nityananda] walks slowly; mora vidyamane — before my eyes; prabhu danda dhare kare — the Lord holds a staff in His hand

122Pondering, Prabhu [Nityananda] walks slowly:
"Before my eyes the Lord holds a staff in His hand!

সে হেন সুন্দর বাঁশী ত্রৈলোক্যমোহন ।
ছাড়িয়া ধরিল দণ্ড — সহিব কেমন ॥ ১২৩ ॥

se hena sundara bāṁśī trailokyamohana |
chāṛiẏā dharila daṇḍa — sahiba kemana || 123 ||

se hena sundara banshi — that beautiful flute; trailokya-mohana — enchanting the three worlds; chhadiya — leaving; dharila danda — He took up a staff; sahiba kemana — how shall I bear it

123Leaving that beautiful flute that enchants the three worlds,
He has taken up a staff — how can I bear it?

সন্ন্যাস করিল প্রভু মুণ্ডাইল মাথা ।
জন্মাবধি রহিল দারুণ এই ব্যথা ॥ ১২৪ ॥

sannyāsa karila prabhu muṇḍāila māthā |
janmābadhi rahila dāruṇa ei byathā || 124 ||

sannyasa karila prabhu — the Lord took sannyasa; mundaila matha — shaved His head; janmavadhi rahila — remains for life; daruna ei vyatha — this cruel pain

124The Lord has taken sannyasa and shaved His head —
this cruel pain will stay [with me] all my life."

চিন্তিতে চিন্তিতে দুঃখ বাড়িল বিস্তর ।
ভাঙ্গিলেন থুঞা দণ্ড ঊরুর উপর ॥ ১২৫ ॥

cintite cintite duḥkha bāṛila bistara |
bhāṅgilena thuñā daṇḍa ūrura upara || 125 ||

chintite chintite — as He pondered; duhkha badila vistara — the grief grew greatly; bhangilena — He broke; thunya danda — placing the staff; urura upara — across His thigh

125The more He pondered, the more His grief grew,
and, setting the staff across His thigh, He broke it.9

ভগ্ন দণ্ড তুলিয়া ফেলিল লঞা জলে ।
প্রভুর তরাসে পাছু ধীরে ধীরে চলে ॥ ১২৬ ॥

bhagna daṇḍa tuliẏā phelila lañā jale |
prabhura tarāse pāchu dhīre dhīre cale || 126 ||

bhagna danda tuliya — lifting the broken staff; phelila lanya jale — threw it into the water; prabhura tarase — in fear of the Lord; pachhu dhire dhire chale — walks slowly behind

126Lifting the broken staff, He threw it into the water,
and, afraid of the Lord, walks slowly behind.

কথোক্ষণে একত্র হইলা দুইজনে ।
সুধাইল প্রভু — দণ্ড না দেখিয়ে কেনে ॥ ১২৭ ॥

kathokṣaṇe ekatra hailā duijane |
sudhāila prabhu — daṇḍa nā dekhiẏe kene || 127 ||

kathokshane — after a while; ekatra haila duijane — the two came together; sudhaila prabhu — the Lord asked; danda na dekhiye kene — why do I not see the staff

127After a while the two came together,
and the Lord asked, "Why do I not see the staff?"

প্রভুর সঙ্কোচে কিছু না দেয় উত্তর ।
বিস্ময় লাগিল প্রভু চিন্তয়ে অন্তর ॥ ১২৮ ॥

prabhura saṅkoce kichu nā deẏa uttara |
bismaẏa lāgila prabhu cintaẏe antara || 128 ||

prabhura sankoche — shrinking before the Lord; kichhu na deya uttara — gives no answer; vismaya lagila — [the Lord] was surprised; prabhu chintaye antara — the Lord pondered within

128Shrinking before the Lord, He gives no answer;
the Lord was surprised and grew thoughtful.

পুনরপি পুছে প্রভু — দণ্ড থুইলে কোথা ।
দণ্ড না দেখিয়া হিয়ায় লাগে বড় ব্যথা ॥ ১২৯ ॥

punarapi puche prabhu — daṇḍa thuile kothā |
daṇḍa nā dekhiẏā hiẏāẏa lāge baṛa byathā || 129 ||

punarapi puchhe prabhu — again the Lord asks; danda thuile kotha — where have You put the staff; danda na dekhiya — not seeing the staff; hiyaya lage bada vyatha — the heart feels great pain

129Again the Lord asks, "Where have You put the staff?
Not seeing the staff, I feel great pain in My heart."

এ বোল শুনিঞা কহে নিত্যানন্দরায় ।
তোর করে দণ্ড দেখি' পোড়ে মো-হিয়ায় ॥ ১৩০ ॥

e bola śuniñā kahe nityānandarāẏa |
tora kare daṇḍa dekhi' poṛe mo-hiẏāẏa || 130 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; kahe nityananda-raya — Nityananda Raya says; tora kare danda dekhi — seeing the staff in Your hand; pode mo-hiyaya — my heart burns

130Hearing this, Nityananda Raya says:
"Seeing the staff in Your hand, I burn all over.

সন্ন্যাস করিলে একে মুড়াইলে মুড় ।
তাহার অধিক দুঃখ — কান্ধে কর দণ্ড ॥ ১৩১ ॥

sannyāsa karile eke muṛāile muṛa |
tāhāra adhika duḥkha — kāndhe kara daṇḍa || 131 ||

sannyasa karile — You took sannyasa; eke mudaile muda — first, You shaved Your head; tahara adhika duhkha — more grievous than that; kandhe kara danda — You carry a staff on Your shoulder

131You took sannyasa — that alone, Your shaving Your head, [was bitter];
and more bitter still, You carry a staff on Your shoulder.

সহিতে না পারি ভাঙ্গি' ফেলাইল জলে ।
যে কর সে কর — গদগদ-ভাষে বোলে ॥ ১৩২ ॥

sahite nā pāri bhāṅgi' phelāila jale |
ye kara se kara — gadagada-bhāṣe bole || 132 ||

sahite na pari — unable to bear it; bhangi phelaila jale — breaking it, I threw it into the water; ye kara se kara — do as You will; gadagada-bhashe bole — He says in a faltering voice

132Unable to bear it, I broke it and threw it into the water.
Do as You will," He says in a faltering voice.

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু ভৈগেল দুঃখিত ।
রুষিয়া কহিল — সব কর বিপরীত ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

e bola śuniñā prabhu bhaigela duḥkhita |
ruṣiẏā kahila — saba kara biparīta || 133 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; prabhu bhaigela duhkhita — the Lord was grieved; rushiya kahila — said angrily; saba kara viparita — You do everything backwards

133Hearing this, the Lord was grieved
and said angrily, "You do everything backwards!

মোর দণ্ডে বৈসে মোর যত দেবগণ ।
হেন দণ্ড ভাঙ্গি' কি সাধিলে প্রয়োজন ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

mora daṇḍe baise mora yata debagaṇa |
hena daṇḍa bhāṅgi' ki sādhile praẏojana || 134 ||

mora dande baise — in My staff abide; mora yata deva-gana — all My gods; hena danda bhangi — breaking such a staff; ki sadhile prayojana — what purpose have You achieved

134In My staff abide all My gods:10
what have You gained by breaking such a staff?

তুমি সদা উনমত — বুদ্ধি স্থির নয় ।
বাতুলের প্রায় রীত — বালক আশয় ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

tumi sadā unamata — buddhi sthira naẏa |
bātulera prāẏa rīta — bālaka āśaẏa || 135 ||

tumi sada unamata — You are always mad; buddhi sthira naya — Your mind is unsteady; vatulera praya rita — Your ways like a lunatic's; balaka ashaya — Your intentions a child's

135You are always mad, Your mind is unsteady;
Your ways are those of a lunatic, Your intentions a child's.

পাণ্ডিত্য-ধর্মেতে ধর্মী নহ কদাচিত ।
আশ্রম ছাড়াও — কার্য কর বিপরীত ॥ ১৩৬ ॥

pāṇḍitya-dharmete dharmī naha kadācita |
āśrama chāṛāo — kārya kara biparīta || 136 ||

panditya-dharmete — in the duty of learning; dharmi naha kadachita — You are never dutiful; ashrama chhadao — You make [Me] abandon the ashrama; karya kara viparita — You act backwards

136Never have You kept the duty that learning requires:
You make [Me] abandon My ashrama — You do everything backwards.

দেবতা-আশ্রম-পীড়া নাহি জান দোষ ।
কিছু যদি বলি তবে কর মহারোষ ॥ ১৩৭ ॥

debatā-āśrama-pīṛā nāhi jāna doṣa |
kichu yadi bali tabe kara mahāroṣa || 137 ||

devata-ashrama-pida — offence to the gods and the ashrama; nahi jana dosha — You do not know as a sin; kichhu yadi bali — if I say anything; tabe kara maha-rosha — then You grow very angry

137You see no sin in offending the gods and [violating] the ashrama,
and if I say anything to You, You grow terribly angry."

এ বোল শুনিঞা নিত্যানন্দ পঁহু হাসে ।
প্রভুরে কহয়ে কিছু গদগদ-ভাষে ॥ ১৩৮ ॥

e bola śuniñā nityānanda paṁhu hāse |
prabhure kahaẏe kichu gadagada-bhāṣe || 138 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; nityananda panhu hase — Nityananda Prabhu laughs; prabhure kahaye kichhu — says something to the Lord; gadagada-bhashe — in a faltering voice

138Hearing this, Nityananda Prabhu laughs
and answers the Lord in a faltering voice:

দেবতা-আশ্রম-পীড়া নাহি করি আমি ।
ভাল কৈল, মন্দ কৈল, সব জান তুমি ॥ ১৩৯ ॥

debatā-āśrama-pīṛā nāhi kari āmi |
bhāla kaila, manda kaila, saba jāna tumi || 139 ||

devata-ashrama-pida — offence to the gods or the ashrama; nahi kari ami — I do not commit; bhala kaila manda kaila — whether I did well or ill; saba jana tumi — You know it all

139"I do not offend the gods or the ashrama;
whether I did well or ill — You know it all.

তোর দণ্ডে বৈসে তোর যত দেবগণ ।
কান্ধে করি' লঞা যাহ — সহিব কেমন ॥ ১৪০ ॥

tora daṇḍe baise tora yata debagaṇa |
kāndhe kari' lañā yāha — sahiba kemana || 140 ||

tora dande baise — in Your staff abide; tora yata deva-gana — all Your gods; kandhe kari lanya yaha — You carry them on Your shoulder; sahiba kemana — how shall I bear it

140In Your staff abide all Your gods —
and You carry them on Your shoulder: how can I bear it?

তুমি তার ভাল কর, আমি করি মন্দ ।
কি কারণে তোর সনে করিব আর দ্বন্দ্ব ॥ ১৪১ ॥

tumi tāra bhāla kara, āmi kari manda |
ki kāraṇe tora sane kariba āra dbandba || 141 ||

tumi tara bhala kara — You do them good; ami kari manda — I do harm; ki karane — why; tora sane kariba ara dvandva — should I argue with You further

141You do them good and I do them harm;
why should I argue with You any further?

অপরাধ কৈলুঁ — দোষ ক্ষম একবার ।
তোর নামে নিস্তারয়ে সকল সংসার ॥ ১৪২ ॥

aparādha kailuṁ — doṣa kṣama ekabāra |
tora nāme nistāraẏe sakala saṃsāra || 142 ||

aparadha kailun — I have offended; dosha kshama ekabara — forgive the fault this once; tora name — by Your name; nistaraye sakala samsara — the whole world is delivered

142I have offended — forgive my fault this once:
by Your name the whole world is delivered.

তোর অধিক পতিত-পাবন নাম তোর ।
এই অপরাধ ক্ষমা করিবেন মোর ॥ ১৪৩ ॥

tora adhika patita-pābana nāma tora |
ei aparādha kṣamā karibena mora || 143 ||

tora adhika — more than You; patita-pavana nama tora — Your name purifies the fallen; ei aparadha — this offence; kshama karibena mora — will be forgiven me

143Your name purifies the fallen even more than You Yourself —
so let this offence of mine be forgiven.11

নামমাত্র নিস্তারয়ে জগতের লোক ।
সন্ন্যাস করিলে — ভক্তগণে বড় শোক ॥ ১৪৪ ॥

nāmamātra nistāraẏe jagatera loka |
sannyāsa karile — bhaktagaṇe baṛa śoka || 144 ||

nama-matra — the name alone; nistaraye jagatera loka — delivers the people of the world; sannyasa karile — You took sannyasa; bhakta-gane bada shoka — the devotees are in great sorrow

144By the name alone the people of the world are delivered —
yet You have taken sannyasa, and the devotees are in great sorrow.

সে হেন বিনোদ-চূড়া মুণ্ডাইলে মাথা ।
ভক্তজন-হৃদয়ে দারুণ এই ব্যথা ॥ ১৪৫ ॥

se hena binoda-cūṛā muṇḍāile māthā |
bhaktajana-hṛdaẏe dāruṇa ei byathā || 145 ||

se hena vinoda-chuda — with that lovely hair; mundaile matha — You shaved Your head; bhakta-jana-hridaye — in the hearts of the devotees; daruna ei vyatha — this cruel pain

145You shaved Your head with that lovely hair —
a cruel pain has lodged in the devotees' hearts.

মোর প্রাণ পোড়ে নিরন্তর ইহা দেখি' ।
হয় নয় পুছ — সর্বভক্ত ইহার সাখী ॥ ১৪৬ ॥

mora prāṇa poṛe nirantara ihā dekhi' |
haẏa naẏa pucha — sarbabhakta ihāra sākhī || 146 ||

mora prana pode — my heart burns; nirantara iha dekhi — ceaselessly seeing this; haya naya puchha — whether so or not, ask; sarva-bhakta ihara sakhi — all the devotees are witnesses to it

146My heart burns ceaselessly seeing this;
whether it is so or not, ask — all the devotees are witnesses.

ভাঙ্গিয়া ফেলিল দণ্ড ভক্তগণ-দুঃখে ।
দণ্ড নহে — শেল যেন ছিল মোর বুকে ॥ ১৪৭ ॥

bhāṅgiẏā phelila daṇḍa bhaktagaṇa-duḥkhe |
daṇḍa nahe — śela yena chila mora buke || 147 ||

bhangiya phelila danda — I broke and threw away the staff; bhakta-gana-duhkhe — for the devotees' grief; danda nahe — not a staff; shela yena chhila mora buke — it was like a spear in my breast

147For the devotees' grief I broke the staff and threw it away:
it was no staff — it was like a spear in my breast."

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু না দিল উত্তর ।
বিরস-বদন — কিছু হরিষ অন্তর ॥ ১৪৮ ॥

e bola śuniñā prabhu nā dila uttara |
birasa-badana — kichu hariṣa antara || 148 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; prabhu na dila uttara — the Lord gave no reply; birasa-badana — His face sad; kichhu harisha antara — some joy within

148Hearing this, the Lord gave no reply:
His face was sad, but in His heart there was secret joy.12

নিত্যানন্দ মহাপ্রভু সব রস জানে ।
ভাঙ্গিয়া ফেলিল দণ্ড — এ লোচন গানে ॥ ১৪৯ ॥

nityānanda mahāprabhu saba rasa jāne |
bhāṅgiẏā phelila daṇḍa — e locana gāne || 149 ||

nityananda mahaprabhu — Nityananda, the great Lord; saba rasa jane — knows all rasas; bhangiya phelila danda — broke and threw away the staff; e lochana gane — sings this Lochana

149Nityananda, the great Lord, knows all rasas:
He broke the staff and threw it away, sings Lochana.

✦

Notes

  1. In the 1983 edition chapter 16, "Sri Nilachala-yatra" ("The Journey to Nilachala"), begins here with new numbering; we follow Bhaktisiddhanta's numbering. Bhaktisiddhanta's summary of this section is at the beginning of en/42. The town is left empty because the Lord has left Bengal for good.
  2. In Murari (3.5.1) the Lord goes "with Mukunda, Gadadhara and others," putting the Avadhuta in front. According to the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 3), Advaita sent four with the Lord: Nityananda, Jagadananda, Damodara Pandita and Mukunda Datta; Lochana Dasa names the companions differently.
  3. The Dola-yatra is the spring swing festival of Krishna on the full moon of the month of Phalguna. According to the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 7), the Lord came to Nilachala in Phalguna and saw the Dola-yatra.
  4. Vv. 85–92 — cf. Murari 3.5.2–3. As a sannyasi, the Lord teaches people by His own example (loka-shiksha): to accept only food offered to Krishna and to live on alms.
  5. The same verse is in Murari (3.5.4–5) and in the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 7.96). Bhaktisiddhanta also mentions it in his summary (en/42).
  6. The toll-collector (dani) took payment from travellers on roads and at ferries. Vv. 96–114 — cf. Murari 3.5.7–9; the Chaitanya-bhagavata (Antya 2) also tells of toll-collectors on the way to Puri.
  7. The Moon of Nilachala is Jagannatha: the toll-collector recognizes in the Lord the Lord of Nilachala Himself.
  8. "Vain" (michha) means "futile", not "unreal" (en/37, note 14). The 1983 edition reads "the feet of Radha" instead of "the feet of Gauranga."
  9. The story of the broken staff is told by Murari (3.5.10–21), in the Chaitanya-bhagavata (Antya 2) and in the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 5): there Nityananda breaks the staff into three pieces and throws it into the river Bhargi. In Murari, Nityananda first excuses Himself by saying he stumbled; in Lochana Dasa He says plainly that he could not bear the sight of the Lord with a sannyasi's staff.
  10. A sannyasi's staff is held to be the abode of the gods (cf. Murari 3.5.16–17).
  11. Cf. the teaching that the Lord's name is more merciful than His form (Rupa Gosvami, Namashtaka 6).
  12. The Lord's anger is lila: in Murari (3.5.18–21) the Lord, setting aside His anger, admits that Nityananda has fulfilled His own intention, and embraces Him; Bhaktisiddhanta, in the edition's table of contents, calls this episode "the manifestation of the pastime of anger" (krodha-lila). Nityananda, the Lord's eternal servant, only carried out His hidden will.
